items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: He said, "You're going to be sorry because they ain't no other drummer you can play with."

ctx.x: Was this when you worked with Woody Herman?

Ok yes. You know what really happened when I was on this engagement. My brother always comes around. He could really play drums but he never worked at it, piano - Jerry Burley, my brother. He's a dancer. He used to tap dance like Baby Laurence, the greatest dancer in the world, just never worked at anything like that. He happened to be in the club one night when I went in. No, it was later. I went to work one night and Glaser's always had an idea to put me with the Woody Herman group. I walked in and he didn't…
